text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: Parallel PID adds proportional, integral, and derivative contributions

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Ideal parallel PID: C(s)=K_p+K_i/s+K_ds=K_c[1+1/(T_is)+T_ds]. All three branch signs are positive at the sum. Practical D is filtered; integral
anti-windup and output limits are additional functions. Parameter mappings depend on controller form; interacting/series PID has different relations.
